Landscaping & drainage in Zachary

Families move to Zachary for the schools - the district is consistently among the top-rated in Louisiana - and for the newer homes and larger lots north of Baton Rouge. Those properties want a finished landscape that keeps its curb appeal, plus dependable year-round care.

What we do here

Full-property care for Zachary homes

Zachary’s growth means a mix of established homes near Main Street and newer subdivisions like Americana and out toward Copper Mill. New builds want a first landscape - beds, sod, drainage - while established homes want renovations and recurring maintenance. We do both from one crew.

The clay soil and flat ground here behave like the rest of the region: rain ponds rather than soaks in. Getting grade and drainage right before sod and beds go in is what keeps a Zachary yard looking good instead of holding water.

Zachary questions

Zachary FAQs

Do you landscape new homes in Zachary?
Yes - the newer subdivisions like Americana and out toward Copper Mill are full of homes that need a first landscape. We grade and handle drainage first, then install beds, plants, sod and edging.
Can you keep our yard maintained year-round?
Yes. Set service days, a clear scope and automatic monthly billing keep a Zachary property sharp without you chasing a crew.
Do you serve established Zachary neighborhoods too?
Absolutely - renovations and bed refreshes on older homes near Main Street are steady work for us here.
What grass grows best in Zachary yards?
Most Zachary-area lawns are St. Augustine or centipede, with zoysia on sunnier lots. We match turf and plant material to your light, your soil and how the space is used, and leave after-care instructions so it establishes.
Do you charge for an estimate in Zachary?
No. Estimates are free with no trip fee and no diagnostic fee. Send a few photos or have us out, and you get a written price with a clearly defined scope, usually the same day.
What other areas near Zachary do you serve?
Plenty. Along with Zachary we regularly work Central, Baton Rouge and Watson and much of Greater Baton Rouge and surrounding areas. If you are not sure we reach you, send your address and we will confirm coverage.
